ja-JP.description: 文化的体系を認知場として開き、由来を保った問い・関係・構造候補を対象側へ戻して検証します。必要な材料統合はcompatible realizationへ委ねます。明示呼び出し専用。

en-US.description: Opens cultural frameworks as cognitive fields, preserves attribution, and returns resulting questions and structure candidates to the target for validation. Delegates material synthesis when a compatible realization is available. Explicit invocation only.
